description: Analyze raw email headers supplied by the user to investigate authentication or delivery issues. Returns the SPF, DKIM and DMARC results reported in those headers, alignment, the sending IP, whether that IP and the From domain are on free public blocklists (not Spamhaus), and detected issues. It does not independently verify DKIM signatures or establish the receiving provider's exact spam-filter decision. Provide headers only, not the message body.
